refsection.title: Description
refsection.para:
Gets the child of the specified `SilikoSyntaxTreeNode` at the specified position, removing the child from the parent.
* `Parent` is a node to get a child node from. * `Position` is the position of the requested child. If the value is non-negative, the `Position` is interpreted as an index counting from the left. If the value is negative, `Position` is interpreted as a n index counting from the right, with `-1` as the left element, and so on. If the value passed would count past the end of the list of child nodes, the value is considered out of range, otherwise the value is considered in range.

refsection.title: Return Values
refsection.para: If `parent` is a branch node, and `position` is in range, this function returns a pointer to the child. Otherwise, this function returns `NULL`. This pointer is no longer managed by the parent and must be passed to `SilikoSyntaxTreeDelete` or added as a child to another branch node to avoid a memory leak.
